dialogues.speaker: Records Left in the Terminal
dialogues.text: "...Regarding the Stellar Blackbody, all seven Kings have been informed..."

dialogues.speaker: Records Left in the Terminal
dialogues.text: "...To ensure the safety of the biosphere, the administrative authority of Researcher Bad-Uru-Namu-Ungien and Researcher Maagees-Geti is hereby temporarily suspended, effective immediately..."

dialogues.speaker: Records Left in the Terminal
dialogues.text: "...Should you have any objections, please contact Security Chief Kalag — Holder of Supreme Clearance..."
